para.text: Start the ruler by clicking the mouse. Move the ruler carefully to the required position, possible added by the co-ordinate display. Release the mouse; the required information is now stored in XYExportB. More accurate data can be obtained when the graph is zoomed in on the required position.

para.text: Method 1: Start the ruler by clicking the mouse. Move the ruler carefully to the first required position and select relative display by clicking the middle button or hitting the spacebar. Move the ruler carefully to the second position and release the mouse. The required information is now stored in XYExportB and XYExportC.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;

para.text: Method 2: Start the ruler by clicking the mouse. Move the ruler carefully to the first required position and release the mouse. DO NOT MOVE THE MOUSE, but press Ctrl and draw a rectangle as for the zooming operation to obtain the second position. Now release the Ctrl key and release the mouse in that order. No zooming action will take place, but the required information will be stored in XYExportA and XYExportB.

Keep in mind that the Alt key is also used by Windows to switch between forms if you hit it without any mouse clicks.
